description: This file defines a Java interface named Query, which specifies the structure for query objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes method signatures for retrieving criteria, sort options, limit, and skip parameters, as well as methods for replacing criteria.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria used for this query.

methods.name: getSortOptions
methods.description: Returns the list of sort options applied to this query.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on the number of results for this query.

methods.name: getSkip
methods.description: Returns the number of results to skip from the beginning.

methods.name: withCritera
methods.description: Deprecated method to replace criteria; delegates to withCriteria.

methods.name: withCriteria
methods.description: Returns a new query instance with the specified criteria.
